meta.title: Bastrop County — the money trail
meta.note: Bastrop County is governed by a Commissioners Court — the County Judge and four County Commissioners — which adopts the county budget and sets the property tax rate each year for the fiscal year beginning October 1. The adopted budget is being ingested now from the county's official document; every line will cite its source page. A dead end here means "not yet ingested and navigable," never "hidden."
